public.title: Merge Sorted Arrays
public.description: Return one nondecreasing array containing every element of the nondecreasing integer arrays left and right, including duplicates. Each input has at most 500 elements with values between -1000000 and 1000000. Empty arrays are allowed. Aim for O(n + m) time.
hints: Compare the next unmerged element in each array.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Advance the pointer with the smaller current value and append that value. When one array is exhausted, append the remaining suffix of the other. Time is O(n + m), with O(n + m) output space.
